name: Pacifist
ability: Executed good players might not die.
interaction: No interaction. When a good player is executed the Storyteller decides whether they die; only the result is announced.
drunk_or_poisoned: No effect: executed good players die as normal.

rulings.text: Announce only whether the executed player died, never why. A surviving execution still counts as the day's execution, so no more nominations that day.
The Storyteller may never trigger it; saving none of five executed good players is legal.
Affects execution only, not exile (an exiled good Bishop dies).
The Pacifist can be executed and survive by its own ability.
Night order numbers are from bra1n/townsquare src/roles.json (develop branch), not the botc-release list.

test_scenarios.name: good executee spared
test_scenarios.setup: 5 players: seat 0 Pacifist, 1 Innkeeper, 2 Chef, 3 Poisoner, 4 Imp
test_scenarios.actions: Day 1: Innkeeper executed; Storyteller chooses to spare
test_scenarios.expected: Execution announced, Innkeeper stays alive, no further nominations that day

test_scenarios.name: good executee dies
test_scenarios.actions: Day 1: Chef executed; Storyteller chooses not to spare

test_scenarios.name: evil executee always dies
test_scenarios.expected: Poisoner dies; no Storyteller choice offered

test_scenarios.name: poisoned pacifist
test_scenarios.setup: Same setup; Poisoner poisons Pacifist on night 1
test_scenarios.expected: Innkeeper dies; no spare option offered
